reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low and I always forget pills at home, so a sachet I can toss in my bag is what I'd actually take. The lab report and the money-back thing make me OK trying one box at the $24.99 price.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? I'm paying $25 to $30 a month for something that might do nothing I can notice, and I'd still have to finish all 30 sachets to get my money back.
would_change_my_mind: If it were $35 or more a box, or if the lab report on the page turned out to be vague or missing for the batch I get, I'd skip it and buy a regular bottle.
